wiki_text: In January 2026, Manzanillo Gas & Power closed financing of US$1.067 billion for the terminal and associated gas-fired power plants — approximately US$902 million in senior debt plus US$165 million in a senior secured letter-of-credit facility, provided by a group of twelve international and local lenders. As of January-March 2026, construction progress on the overall project was reported at roughly 40-45%, with grid energy injection targeted for late 2027 and full completion expected in early 2028, consistent with GEM's existing LatestPlannedStartYear of 2028.

source_urls.title: Manzanillo Gas & Power consigue financiamiento de los US$1,067 millones para su ejecución total
